title: Postern run request
description: Request body of POST /postern/v0/run and POST /postern/v0/stream. Both verbs take the same body. See SPEC.md section 4.2.

inputs.description: Map keyed by the input keys declared in the describe response. A runner MUST reject a request omitting a required input, or failing a declared validation, with bad_request. Values follow the value space of the three input types (SPEC.md section 4.1.1): a string for text and select, a number for number, null for no value. No v0 input type produces a boolean.
